column7: With several key directories on one PostgreSQL database (key_dir_lock: database, Helm Secret mode, per-host key copies), a server booting from a directory without dek.key.pending between a DEK rotation's sweep commit and its rename cleared the redo marker, so the rotating directory's next recovery discarded the only copy of the new DEK (every row lost). The marker is now kept unless this directory promotes the pending DEK or the DEK epoch proves it already holds the new one. Siblings: TestDEKRotation_Postgres_RotateFromStaleKeyDirKeepsTheRedoMarker, TestDEKRotation_Postgres_CompletedRotationMarkerClearedOnceEpochMatches, TestDEKRotation_Postgres_RotationClearsALeftoverMarkerBeforeStaging.
